Lead Roman weight. The weight is flat on the top and the bottom and has slatnted sides making it trapazoidal in scetion. On the top is inscribed VIII, represetng eight in Roman numerals. On each of the letters is a head and foot serif. It weighs 219g, which divided by its indicated mass (eight) makes divisions of 27.375, which is 0.075g underweight for each ounce.
